item.title: Rolla Man Seriously Injured in Accident Near Mountain Grove - Ozark Radio News
item.description: A 57-year-old Rolla man sustained serious injuries in an accident on MM Highway near Mountain Grove on Wednesday. The accident occurred when he entered a corner too fast for the conditions and ran off the roadway in the 2016 Peterbilt he was driving and overturned. He was transported to Cox South in Springfield for treatment.

item.title: Fatal Accident South of Mansfield Thursday Morning - Ozark Radio News
item.description: According to Sgt. Eddie Young of the Missouri State Highway Patrol a fatal accident occurred this morning around 7 a.m. on Highway 5, five miles south of Mansfield involving two vehicles. A detour was established as they performed a crash reconstruction, more detail will be reported as they become available.
